author: Elastic
description: 检测macOS经Shell配置文件执行curl。对应需求：持久化。官方：Curl Execution via Shell Profile。
name: 【默认】macOS经Shell配置文件执行curl
note:
## 调查指引

### 规则说明
macOS经Shell配置文件执行curl

### 为何重要
在重启或登录后保持立足点

### 调查步骤
1. 核对告警实体、进程/网络字段与时间窗。
2. 核对是否符合变更窗口与已知业务工具。
3. 关联同主机或同账号前后同类告警。

### 常见误报
- 合法变更窗口内的运维、发布或安全扫描

### 响应建议
1. 确认是否授权与变更窗口。
2. 无授权则隔离相关主机或账号并排查落地与外连。
3. 按主机与用户关联前后同类告警。
query:
sequence with maxspan=10s
  [process where host.os.type == "macos" and event.type == "start" and event.action == "exec" and
    process.name in ("bash", "zsh", "sh") and
    process.args in ("-zsh", "-sh", "-bash") and process.args_count == 1 and
    process.parent.name == "login"] by process.entity_id
  [process where host.os.type == "macos" and event.type == "start" and event.action == "exec" and
    process.name in ("curl", "nscurl") and
    process.args in ("-o", "--output", "--download", "-dl", "-dir", "--directory", "-F", "--form") and
    not process.args like ("https://upload.elastic.co*", "https://vault-ci-prod.elastic.dev", "https://artifacts.elastic.co*")] by process.parent.entity_id
false_positives: 合法变更窗口内的运维、发布或安全扫描
setup:
## 设置说明

1. 目标 macOS 主机安装 Elastic Agent，启用 **Elastic Defend**。
2. 确认相关数据流有数据后再评估告警。
